sections.title: Items
sections.note: Potions go in two potion slots; Spirit Tracks has no bottles. Train cars are in Train Parts, songs in Songs.

tiers.name: Recruit's Sword
tiers.howTo: After the disaster at the tower, pass Captain Russell's lesson in the training room on the east side of Hyrule Castle's first floor.

tiers.name: Lokomo Sword
tiers.howTo: Anjean gives it in the Spirit Train after you bring the Bow of Light out of the Sand Temple.
tiers.reward: Stuns Phantoms without Tears of Light

items.name: Spirit Flute
items.howTo: After the disaster, Zelda's spirit asks you to bring it from her chamber in Hyrule Castle.
items.notes: Played by blowing into the microphone while sliding the pipes. Anjean gave it to Zelda's ancestors.

items.name: Shield
items.howTo: Buy it for 80 Rupees at the Castle Town Shop (east of the castle entrance) or the Whittleton shop.
items.notes: Pricier elsewhere: 200 Rupees at the Goron Country Store, more at the Snow Sanctuary. A Like Like can eat it; buy another.

items.name: Whirlwind
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Forest Temple: the chest after the four Vengas on 2F.

items.name: Stamp Book
items.howTo: Niko gives it in your house after you bring Alfonzo home to Aboda Village.
items.notes: The stamps are in their own tracker.

items.name: Rabbit Net
items.howTo: Stop at Rabbitland Rescue on the north-west line towards the Snow Realm and tell Bunnio how much you love rabbits.
items.notes: The rabbits are in their own tracker.

items.name: Boomerang
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Snow Temple: the chest after the three Ice Keese on B1.

items.name: Shield of Antiquity
items.howTo: Show Niko 10 stamps in the Stamp Book.
items.notes: The Hero of Winds' shield from Phantom Hourglass. Like Likes can't eat it. Swap shields at the fireplace in your house. Needed for speedrun.com's 100%.

items.name: Whip
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Ocean Temple: beat the Snapper on 3F.

items.name: Engineer's Clothes
items.howTo: Show Niko 15 stamps in the Stamp Book; talk to him to switch between them and the Recruit Uniform.
items.notes: The clothes Link starts in. No effect in play. Needed for speedrun.com's 100%.

tiers.name: Bow
tiers.howTo: The Fire Temple's item: beat the Heatoise mini-boss on 2F.

tiers.name: Bow of Light
tiers.howTo: In the Sand Temple, in the chest down the stairs past Skeldritch.
tiers.reward: Light Arrows: hold the stylus to charge

items.name: Sand Wand
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Sand Temple: past the three Stalfos Warriors on 3F.

sections.title: Upgrades
sections.note: Bombs are optional: the first Bomb Bag is bought, the next two are minigame prizes.

items.name: Bomb Bag
items.notes: IGN says the first bag holds 20; Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon say 10, 20 and 30.

tiers.name: Bomb Bag (10)
tiers.howTo: Buy it from Beedle's Air Shop for 500 Rupees. His balloon appears on the map after the Snow Temple: whistle when it's near the tracks and stop beside it.

tiers.name: Medium Bomb Bag (20)
tiers.howTo: Whittleton's Whip Race (north-east of the village, 50 Rupees): finish under 1:30 (1:15 or better wins the Heart Container).

tiers.name: Big Bomb Bag (30)
tiers.howTo: Clear level 2 (blue door) of Take 'Em All On! in Castle Town, open after the Ocean Temple.

items.name: Quiver
items.notes: The two upgrades are 30 and 50 arrows. Which source gives which differs: the Goron store gives 30 and the Pirate Hideout 50 (Zelda Wiki, IGN), or the reverse (Zelda Dungeon). Most likely whichever you get first gives 30.

tiers.name: Quiver (20)
tiers.howTo: Comes with the Bow in the Fire Temple.

tiers.name: Quiver (30)
tiers.howTo: Buy the Quiver at the Goron Country Store in Goron Village for 2,000 Rupees after the Fire Temple, or score 3,000–3,999 at the Pirate Hideout.

tiers.name: Quiver (50)
tiers.howTo: The other of the two: the Goron Country Store's 2,000-Rupee Quiver, or 3,000–3,999 points at the Pirate Hideout minigame.

items.name: Great Spin Attack
items.reward: Swordsman's Scroll: three spin attacks in a row
items.notes: Zelda Wiki calls it the second Swordsman's Scroll, Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough the first. Leaves Link dizzy.

items.name: Sword Beam
items.howTo: Bring all 50 rabbits to Bunnio at Rabbitland Rescue.
items.reward: Swordsman's Scroll: sword beams at full health
